searches.reason: Replace configuration-only residual diagnostics with measured component contributions. Seek practical paired interventions on fixed training prefixes: disable the residual, remove recent or older interactions, and shuffle order while preserving item counts. Measure target-rank changes and top-10 turnover against uniform-history and last-item controls, stratified by history length and training frequency. Distinguish model sensitivity from causal claims about user intent.

searches.reason: Turn qualitative feedback into an auditable failure taxonomy: specific-interest match, broad association, apparent duplication, and unsupported compatibility assumptions. Investigate title/description evidence and explicit abstention when specifications or intent are unknown. Use the twenty training-user recommendation exercises to assess annotation agreement and evidence coverage; never infer ownership, purchase necessity, or latent traits from interactions alone.
searches.query: recommendation diagnostic evaluation actionable relevance redundancy compatibility evidence grounded user feedback taxonomy annotation agreement abstention product titles descriptions 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Establish whether diagnostic signals survive changes in candidate difficulty and representation scale. Seek bounded training-prefix audits comparing fixed uniform, popularity-matched, and content-similar negatives with full-catalog ranks; complement mean cosine with centered effective rank and recommendation concentration. Calibrate using controlled representation degradation and paired uncertainty estimates, while keeping official macro validation HR@10 as the sole selection objective.
